plain_text:
Getting the word out about science-based,
healthy lifestyle tips is a challenge. People
are short on time and bombarded with
information from unreliable sources. The National
Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases
(NIDDK) wants to cut through the noise.
semantic_text:
Getting the word out about science-based, healthy lifestyle tips is a challenge. People are short on time and bombarded with information from unreliable sources. The National Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases
(NIDDK) wants to cut through the noise.

plain_text:
Every week, the Healthy Moments radio broadcast


shares valuable information in one-minute episodes.


NIDDK Director Griffin P. Rodgers, M.D., hosts the
series and often features special guests. The show covers
topics related to NIDDK's mission and the conditions
they study.
semantic_text:
Every week, the Healthy Moments radio broadcast

shares valuable information in one-minute episodes.

NIDDK Director Griffin P. Rodgers, M.D., hosts the series and often features special guests. The show covers topics related to NIDDK's mission and the conditions they study.

plain_text:
Healthy Moments premiered in 2008 on one station in
Washington, DC. Episodes have focused on diabetes,
healthy eating and weight management, digestive diseases
such as irritable bowel syndrome and celiac disease, liver
disease, and prostate health, among others. Episodes have
also covered what it's like to participate in clinical trials
at NIH. Listeners can learn how NIDDK works to improve
equity and diversity in health care and in the biomedical
research workforce.

plain_text:
Over the past decade, we've grown
to about 60 million listeners.

plain_text:
"Over the past decade, we've grown to about 60 million listeners.
Healthy Moments is syndicated on stations across the country,
particularly in areas with the highest rate of conditions within
NIDDK's mission," Dr. Rodgers said.

plain_text:
Past celebrity guests include Barbra Streisand, Sugar Ray Leonard,
Debbie Allen, and Laila Ali. NIH researchers and directors also
share their expertise in an easy-to-understand, quick format.

If your local radio does not broadcast Healthy Moments, you
can stream episodes on NIDDK's website. Check out some
videos—including some Spanish-translated episodes—on
the institute's YouTube channel. NIDDK also provides text
transcripts of each episode.
